description:
Timesheet totals for a ticket, pushed by Odoo when it is marked done
(the manual deployment step). Fire-and-forget from Odoo's side: no
callback echoes it. A re-done ticket re-sends its totals — latest wins.

actual_hours.description: Total timesheet hours booked on the ticket at done-time
actual_hours.title: Actual Hours

timesheet_line_count.description: Number of timesheet lines behind the total
timesheet_line_count.title: Timesheet Line Count
